appraisal_events.evidence: « Je ne conteste pas son talent de peintre... Mais il me semble que notre temps fait une confusion de genres et que le propre du romancier est plutôt de nouer une intrigue et d'élever les coeurs que de fignoler à la pointe sèche un frontispice ou un cul-de-lampe. »
appraisal_events.explanation: Norpois grants Bergotte a narrow decorative skill while denying him standing as a true novelist, a backhanded critique delivered as authoritative literary judgment.

appraisal_events.evidence: « Ah ! ne dites pas de mal de Bergotte, s'écria la duchesse. »
appraisal_events.explanation: The duchess immediately and openly defends Bergotte's reputation against Norpois's disparagement.

appraisal_events.evidence: « Vous m'aviez montré une oeuvrette un peu tarabiscotée où vous coupiez les cheveux en quatre. Je vous ai donné franchement mon avis ; ce que vous aviez fait ne valait pas la peine que vous le couchiez sur le papier. »
appraisal_events.explanation: Norpois bluntly and publicly dismisses the narrator's earlier piece of writing as worthless, directly criticizing him as a social participant in the conversation.

status_effects.explanation: His literary standing is contested: Norpois's extended, substantive dismissal outweighs the duchess's brief one-line defense, leaving a mild net discredit locally.
As a staged participant, he receives a blunt, socially public dismissal of his writing from an authoritative figure, diminishing his standing in the exchange.

ambiguities: Norpois's exaggerated, ceremonious bow to Bloch just before this excerpt ('comme s'il l'inclinait devant tout ce que lui représentait de notoire et d'imposant le nom de Bloch') carries narratorial irony about Norpois's own hollow formality, but its target is really Bloch's reception (an already-scored character), so it was not scored here as a separate movement toward Norpois.

Whether Norpois's judgment of Bergotte is meant to be read as ironized (given his established pomposity) or simply neutrally reported quoted speech is not fully resolved by this passage alone; a more conservative neutral_report stance was chosen.
